meta.title: ILLUSTRATIVE food plant section (synthetic): ammonia refrigeration, dryer, oven, fryer and utilities
meta.not_a_drawing_of_record: ILLUSTRATIVE. A synthetic model written by hand to exercise the refrigeration, oven, dryer and fryer questions. It is not any plant, no plant's drawing or data was used, and every tag is invented. No public source gives a food plant P&ID to transcribe, so each item instead names the public source that describes that kind of item in food plants (source keys as in data/questions.json; p. = the source's printed page). Nothing here is a measurement.

sources.S25: Brush, Masanet and Worrell, Dairy Processing ENERGY STAR guide, LBNL-6261E (2011), https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/1171534
sources.S26: Masanet, Worrell, Graus and Galitsky, Fruit and Vegetable Processing ENERGY STAR guide, LBNL-59289-Revision (2008), https://eta-publications.lbl.gov/sites/default/files/lbnl-59289-rev.pdf
sources.S27: DOE Process Heating Tip Sheet #2, Check Burner Air to Fuel Ratios (2007), https://www1.eere.energy.gov/manufacturing/tech_assistance/pdfs/42110.pdf

meta.drawn_on_purpose: Anti-triggers, each placed to show a question staying quiet: K-203 has a variable speed drive (E29), EV-202 starts defrost on demand from a coil differential pressure (E30), K-201's motor power is measured (C12), the oven has a flue O2 analyser (E32), the fryer's exhaust goes to a vapour condenser heat recovery exchanger (E31, H6), and the instrument air compressor and its refrigerated air dryer are not refrigeration plant or a process dryer.
